x-provenance.note: This is the stdio server's tool list as shipped in the provider's package source, NOT a live tools/list response: the hosted endpoint https://agent.humanbrowser.cloud/mcp answers tools/list with HTTP 401 anonymously. The agent card's MCP section names the same three tools with the same arguments.

tools.name: humanbrowser_run
tools.description: Run a Human Browser cloud task. Drives a cloud Chromium (Patchright + Camoufox + residential proxy) to accomplish the given goal. Blocks until terminal state. Returns the final natural-language answer plus a live viewer URL a human can open to watch.

goal.description: Natural-language task for the cloud browser agent.

country.description: ISO country code for the residential proxy (e.g. "us", "gb", "de"). Optional.

profile.description: Persistent profile name (cookies + storage survive across runs). Optional.

tools.name: humanbrowser_stream
tools.description: Same as humanbrowser_run but streams agent status as MCP progress notifications while the task is in flight. Use when you want live visibility into a long-running task.

goal.description: Natural-language task for the cloud browser agent.

country.description: ISO country code for the residential proxy (e.g. "us", "gb", "de"). Optional.

profile.description: Persistent profile name (cookies + storage survive across runs). Optional.

tools.name: humanbrowser_viewer_url
tools.description: Fetch the live viewer URL for a previously-started task by id. Useful for re-attaching a human watcher to an in-flight or completed task.

task_id.description: Task id returned by a prior humanbrowser_run/stream call.
